data.text/markdown:
Copenhagen FEATHER hospital experiment

This notebook uses the full Copenhagen walking graph. Settings:
  • Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Denmark
  • Amenity: hospital
  • theta_max = 2.5
  • eval_points = 2
  • order = 1
  • Visualization column: cos_r1_theta0
FEATHER and FEATHER_new use exactly the same hospital-distance node feature. The difference is the transition matrix:
  • FEATHER: unweighted topology
  • FEATHER_new: inverse edge length weighting

3. Walking distance to nearest hospital

The shortest-path calculation uses the original OSMnx graph. OSMnx's length edge attribute is already in metres, so the resulting feature is walking-network distance in metres.

data.text/markdown:
4. Relabel graph for FEATHER

OSMnx uses large OpenStreetMap node IDs. The current FEATHER implementation expects: 0, 1, 2, ..., N-1

5. Run FEATHER

Original FEATHER uses unweighted topology. With eval_points = 2 and order = 1, each node gets four output values:
  • cos_r1_theta0
  • cos_r1_theta1
  • sin_r1_theta0
  • sin_r1_theta1
